class.name: OcgXscontrolVars
class.brief_description: Defines a receptacle for externally defined variables, each one has a name
class.description: ! Defines a receptacle for externally defined variables, each ! one has a name ! ! I.E. a WorkSession for XSTEP is generally used inside a ! context, which brings variables, especially shapes and ! geometries. For instance DRAW or an application engine ! ! This class provides a common form for this. It also provides ! a default implementation (locally recorded variables in a ! dictionary), but which is aimed to be redefined
